title: Exi's Experiment #1 - Horrific Creatures
description: This modpack is filled with horror mods, weapons, advanced mobAIs and new biomes
body:
**I do not own any of the content that are in the modpack, All work, mods, resourcepacks & shaders go to the original authors.**

This modpack features several classic horror mods, some notable mods in this pack are listed below
<details>
<summary>The Notable Mods</summary>

- "The Boiled One: Reimagined" by Hqrvester - A horrific entity who will attempt to either attack, stalk or paralyze you, he will stalk the player before attacking, but if you are in a bed, he will watch you sleep and get closer until he is on the bed, which he will have a high chance to paralyze you 

- "Slenderman" by Bloxy - The infamous slenderman, the man in the woods who you need 7 papers to defeat, if you take one his papers then he shall begin his hunt.

- "Sanity: Descent Into Madness" by croissantnova - You have limited sanity, if it goes down the voices in your head start speaking to you until it takes a "physical" manifestation & tries to attack you.
</details>
